$comment: Which models this deployment is permitted to read labels with. A technical administrator's decision, recorded here because there is nowhere better yet — D14 leaves the prototype unauthenticated, so a runtime admin surface would be an affordance without a gate behind it. Keeping it in the repository means the decision is versioned, reviewed and diffable, which is more than a dashboard setting offers. When an authenticated admin surface exists this file becomes its seed, not its replacement.

approvals.rationale: Natively multimodal with tool calling; the first reader wired. Fully qualified, so the identifier cannot move under the audit record (D29).

Second reader, added so B-Q4 can be measured rather than argued. Note the weaker pin: Google retired numbered versions after 2.0, so this is a stable name that can be repointed. The per-job fingerprint exists to make that detectable.
